text:
maria: Heads up — can someone confirm whether the ad-hoc audit export includes request_body_hash and user_agent by default? Need this for a legal request.

devon: not by default for privacy reasons — request_body_hash is included, user_agent is excluded (we avoid headers unless explicitly requested). cc @alek for access perms

alek: You can run ad-hoc via the admin tool (`audit-export`). It writes parquet to s3://redwood-audit-exports/{timestamp}/. Example query we use to build slices:
```
SELECT event_id, actor_id, verb, resource, request_body_hash
FROM audit_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2025-02-01' AND '2025-03-01'
```

jordan: who is allowed to run that? need quick approval path for legal.

alek: permission model: security-admins + legal-oncall can trigger exports. For exports >30 days of data we require 2 approvers (security lead + legal). Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/audit-exports (shorted here). Presigned URLs expire in 7 days by default.

irina: redaction: automated rules strip emails and SSNs from `payload` (we replace with `<REDACTED>`). IPs are anonymized to /24 unless legal asks for full. If legal needs unredacted fields that's an escalation and requires CTO sign-off + logged justification.

sec-bot: EXPORT JOB STARTED: audit-export-1960001111.tar.gz -> s3://redwood-audit-exports/1960001111/ (presigned URL expires in 7d) :package:

maria: thanks. Can we also get an exact column list and retention policy? legal specifically asked for a 90d archive.

alek: column list we include by default: event_id, ts, actor_id, actor_email_redacted, verb, resource, request_body_hash, payload_redacted, ip_anonymized, service, region. Retention: hot storage default 180d, archived 365d for enterprise customers. We can produce a 90d ad-hoc slice on request.

devon: i'll add a quick note to the runbook clarifying which fields are redacted vs included and the approver flow. ping me with the S3 path and I'll update the approvers list.

maria: if an export accidentally contains unredacted PII, what is the rollback/mitigation? @irina

irina: mitigation steps: 1) revoke presigned URL immediately, 2) rotate the export KMS key to make existing files unreadable, 3) notify legal & infra, 4) lock down audit-access group and run a short postmortem. We treat PII leaks as Sev2+ by policy.

maria: great — that's exactly what I needed. I'll escalate to legal with this info. :thumbsup:
